𝌋‌⟐ **Q1 PAID-EXECUTION HOLD — exact source review at `67339318d5a430541a572c19833817271d69c5f3`**

Q1 A/C design, request digests, matched model settings, first-return strategy, and introductory pricing are supported. Two stated live-execution guarantees are not yet implemented:

**(1) $1.00 HARD CAP — not enforced.** The runner estimates cost but never uses usage metadata or cumulative spend to gate the next call. It enforces 8 calls only. With `maxOutputTokens: 65536`, eight maximal output allowances alone cost `$1.96608` at the verified $3.75/1M rate, before input. Please enforce the operator's dollar ceiling via conservative per-next-call upper-bound reservation and measured cumulative actual usage; fail closed if usage is unavailable or unreliable. A true $1 cap may stop before slot S08; disclose this instead of silently modifying historically matched generation settings. Alternatively, present a separately authorized revised dollar ceiling.

**(2) `STOP_4` SSE-to-text integrity — absent.** The runner parses concatenated SSE frames and saves raw bytes but has no independent `textEquivalent` check or stopping branch for mismatches; parsing errors can also bypass a final partial acquisition receipt. Implement a verified canonical reconstruction check and fail-closed `STOP_4`, retaining raw first returns and a terminal receipt on parser failure.

**(3) FINISH / SOURCE GUARDS.** Handle missing/unexpected `modelVersion`, non-STOP incomplete finishes (`MAX_TOKENS` etc.), and meaningful generation-config drift explicitly. Add zero-network tests for budget reservation, missing usage, mismatched/malformed SSE, partial receipts, and no extra calls.

Any correction changes the exact HEAD. Re-run preflight/CI, document the updated cost ceiling and experimental equivalence, and request a **new, exact-SHA operator authorization**. Until then: `Q1_DESIGN_SUPPORTED`, `PAID_EXECUTION_HELD`, `Q2_HELD`, `DO_NOT_MERGE`, `ARTISTIC_CLOSURE_RESERVED`.
